social_circle.name: Tommy Rubel

background.how_they_met: They met locally before marrying; exact circumstances are not specified in the interview.
background.why_close: They have been married about 27 years, raised Marissa and Caleb together, live together full time, share household expenses, and coordinate repairs, family routines, and storm preparation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief and practical, focused on work, bills, repairs, groceries, weather, and family plans.

recent_text_topics: Friday paycheck timing, bill payments, truck gas, and whether a repair can wait.
Groceries, medicine, batteries, or supplies for storm season.
Checking on his back strain and reminding him to rest after maintenance shifts.
Coordinating when Caleb, Marissa, or Eli are coming for Sunday lunch.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: 'I am married to Tommy Rubel. He works maintenance around the shipyard side of things, and he is quieter than me but steady.' Q51: 'It is just the two of us full time.' Q35 notes Tommy's back strain from work.
